papers.scope: Sections 2–5 and Appendix A. Kernel, isolated-pole denominator exponents, prime-density and phase bounds.
Sections 2–4. Powered kernels, prime dilation, and the earlier upper endpoints 74 and 110.

locations_checked.ballrivoal, rzbeta: Ball and Rivoal's odd-zeta linear forms and Rivoal and Zudilin's Lemma 2 on alternating half-integer sums for even beta values.
locations_checked.zudbeta, laizhou: Zudilin's proof of Lemma 1 and Section 3 use zeros in the pole interval. Lai and Zhou, Theorem 6.1, specify the changed block parameters and normalization for the interval ending at beta(10).
locations_checked.rivoal, krisman: Rivoal, Section 2, Lemma 1, removes zeta(3) by a second derivative. Krisman, Sections 1.2 and 4 and Lemma 4.6, adapts differentiation and the use of zeros to even beta values.
locations_checked.laisprang, powered, fifteen: Lai and Sprang, Lemma 2.3, supplies the auxiliary-prime nonvanishing criterion. The prime-dilation formulas are in Section 4 of the powered-kernel paper and Section 5 of the fifteen-value paper.
